note: The tools tauri-bundler 2.9.2 runs to make the Linux AppImage (bundle/linux/appimage/linuxdeploy.rs, prepare_tools). The bundler downloads any of them missing from its cache, unchecked; AppRun and the GTK hook ship inside the AppImage. scripts/release/appimage-tools.mjs installs them into that cache first, each checked against its SHA-256 here. The two plugin scripts are pinned to a commit. The three binaries are release assets upstream can replace, and linuxdeploy-plugin-appimage's 'continuous' release is rebuilt from time to time: a mismatch means upstream changed the asset, so inspect the new file and update its pin deliberately, in a commit of its own.
